verification: CP32 moves Admin/Mod Hub drafts, moderation submissions, review status and audit records into shared Supabase storage. Admin publishes each Hub revision through an Admin-only RPC; the public homepage, map and Hub details read only published values through a read-only registry API, while browser-local drafts never become public automatically. RLS and RPC grants prevent anonymous writes, and the Worker verifies staff sessions and roles. CI, Worker dry-run, Cloudflare deployment, anonymous-denial smoke, public registry smoke and production smoke are mandatory.
